maddeler.e:
تعتصمين (form VIII)
# تَعْتَصِمِينَ (taʕtaṣimīna) /taʕ.ta.sˤi.miː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِعْتَصَمَ (iʕtaṣama)
# تُعْتَصَمِينَ (tuʕtaṣamīna) /tuʕ.ta.sˤa.miː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَصَمَ (iʕtaṣama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
